canonical_question: Does the change in n at 700 °C from 0.48 to 0.72 occur at the same time as a morphological change in the oxide scale visible in Figure 2c?

question_variants.question: Does the change in n at 700 °C from 0.48 to 0.72 occur at the same time as a morphological change in the oxide scale visible in Figure 2c?
question_variants.resolution_summary: The provided text confirms the change in the kinetic exponent n occurs at a specific time interval (longer than 5h) and describes the morphology at 800°C (whiskers, Figure 7), but it does not explicitly link the timing of the n change at 700°C to a specific morphological change visible in Figure 2c, nor does it describe the morphology in Figure 2c in the context of the n value change.

answers.answer: The text states that the kinetics changed from nearly parabolic (n = 0.48) to mixed parabolic-linear (n = 0.72) at a longer time of testing, but it does not specify if this coincides with the morphology in Figure 2c.
answers.measurement_outcome: Kinetic exponent n changed from 0.48 to 0.72 at longer times
answers.mechanism: Transition from parabolic to mixed parabolic-linear oxidation
answers.boundary_limitation: No explicit link provided between the time of n change and the specific morphology in Figure 2c.
evidence_spans: Figure 1 a shows the XRD pattern of the AlNbTiVZr 0.25 alloy in the initial (annealed at 1200 °C for 24 h) condition.

In the XRD pattern, the Bragg peaks belonging to two phases, namely B2 and Zr 5 Al 3 , were found; the lattice parameters of B2 and Zr 5 Al 3 phases were a = 0.3203 nm and a = 0.7996 nm, c = 0.5374 nm, respectively.

The alloy consisted of two structural constituents: (i) B2 grains (labeled with 1 in Figure 1 b) with the average size of ~80 μm and the chemical composition close to that of the alloy ( Table 1 ) and (ii) light-grey (Zr, Al)-rich particles (labeled with 2 in Figure 1 b; Table 1 ) identified as the Zr 5 Al 3 phase located both along the boundaries of the B2 grains as a discontinuous network and as separate particles or clusters of these particles in the B2 grains interior.

source_evidence_spans: Nearly parabolic kinetics (n = 0.48) observed from 0 to 5 h changed by mixed parabolic-linear (n = 0.72) one at longer time of testing
